executive_assessment.text: Popua/Sopu and outer-island Ha'apai/Vava'u water dependence add local exposure and sensitivity, with older observations and future inundation scenarios kept distinct.
Village water committees, coastal planting and community programme targets add institutional detail. Monitoring and delivered-outcome gaps remain explicit.

geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2025 reports: The government review reports current coastal flooding in low-lying Popua and Sopu; Sopu wetlands buffer high tides by about 30 cm, but the protection is weakening as seas rise.
Source dated 2025 reports: A 2025 review summarizes an ADB (2019) projection that by about 2090 high tides may inundate low-lying Nuku'alofa, possibly forcing residential-area abandonment.

Source dated 2025 reports: Tonga's 2020-2023 One Million Trees initiative planted mostly mangroves; the review says it may have strengthened coastal resilience, but land saved is unquantified and Sopu's wetland buffer may be shrinking.

Source dated 2023-12 reports: The assessment identifies drought and possible groundwater salinization on low-lying Ha'apai islands; some remote Ha'apai and Vava'u islands rely solely on rainwater and face rainfall variation.
The TNA cites 2019 government information identifying drought vulnerability nationally, with higher proportions in Tongatapu and Vava'u.

Source dated not stated reports: Live & Learn describes a 2021-2026 programme across 15 communities in Ha'apai (4), Vava'u (8) and 'Eua (3), targeting community plans, nature-based actions, training for 20 representatives and direct actions for 20 households per site.

known_gaps.text: Automated machine-screening is not independent source verification or human approval. 14 of 15 evidence records and 0 of 0 pathways lack claim-level verification in this remediation; review the linked records before relying on them.

The Nuku'alofa high-tide inundation estimate is reported through a 2025 government review citing ADB (2019); the underlying scenario is unspecified in the summary.

The Live & Learn page reports programme design and targets, not verified completion or evaluated resilience outcomes; the linked community-profile PDF was not accessible.
